registry.rationale: Core psoriatic and neutrophilic inflammation axis with established dermatology therapeutics.
Atopic dermatitis epithelial barrier and type 2 inflammatory biology.
Shared interferon, autoimmune, and JAK-inhibitor-relevant biology across alopecia, vitiligo, lupus, and dermatitis.
Innate inflammatory axis relevant to pustular psoriasis, hidradenitis, and autoinflammatory phenotypes.
Hidradenitis suppurativa genetic and follicular differentiation module.
Vitiligo melanocyte autoantigen and antigen-presentation biology.
Cutaneous lupus and humoral autoimmunity module with translational precedent.
Recruitment module spanning neutrophilic, Th1, Th2, monocyte, and lymphoid-aggregate biology.
Immune-complex and innate effector biology, most relevant to lupus-spectrum disease.
Barrier, keratinocyte differentiation, and inherited inflammatory skin-disease context.
T-cell activation and checkpoint biology relevant to autoimmune inflammatory skin diseases.
